title: Suspension Allowance and Residency-End Proration Terms, Personal Services Plan
content:
Four tier figures of the Personal Services Plan concern time away and the end of a residency: the maximum suspended calendar months in any rolling 12-month window, the minimum length of the absence that justifies a suspension, the calendar days before the first suspended month by which a suspension must be requested, and whether the package fee of the month in which the residency ends is prorated by days.

| Tier | Maximum suspended months per rolling 12 months | Minimum absence (days) | Suspension notice (calendar days before the first suspended month) | Package fee prorated by days when the residency ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 0 | 14 | 7 | Yes |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 2 | 14 | 7 | Yes |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 2 | 14 | 7 | Yes |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 3 | 14 | 7 | Yes |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 3 | 14 | 7 | Yes |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 3 | 14 | 7 | Yes |

## Notes

- The figure is 0 months on the Pay-As-You-Go Plan, 2 months on the Essentials and Companion Packages, and 3 months on the Comfort, Premier and Concierge Packages.
- The minimum absence of 14 days and the notice of 7 calendar days are the same on every tier.
- Proration of the package fee on the end of a residency applies on every tier.
